theme: Light mode with industrial orange accents
archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC (Orange accent) Hybrid

rules: Never use Inter or generic sans for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk for industrial weight.
Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Overlines and labels must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing.
Data tables must use monospaced fonts for numerical alignment.
Use orange ONLY for primary CTAs (e.g., 'Generate PDF', 'Save Quote') and critical data highlights.
Never use pure black or pure gray. Grays are tinted with cool slate.
Backgrounds should be flat, no generic full-screen gradients.

dashboard.usage: For the persistent saved quotes history and P&L overview.

quote_builder.usage: For the quote data entry. Left column (col-span-8) for line items and calculations, Right column (col-span-4) for global settings (currency, tax, payment terms, delivery lead time).

surfaces.card: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-none shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200 p-6
surfaces.header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-slate-200

buttons.primary: bg-orange-600 text-white hover:bg-orange-700 font-medium px-6 py-2 rounded-none transition-colors duration-200
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 font-medium px-6 py-2 rounded-none transition-colors duration-200

inputs.text: border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500 focus:border-orange-500 transition-colors text-slate-900
inputs.select: border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500 transition-colors text-slate-900
inputs.table_input: border-0 border-b border-transparent hover:border-slate-300 focus:border-orange-500 bg-transparent px-2 py-1 focus:bg-orange-50 w-full text-sm font-mono transition-colors

rules: Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions. Use Shadcn JS components.
Go cardless or use extremely sharp, rectangular, dense styles (rounded-none).
Use standard Shadcn components for tables, dropdowns, dialogs, tabs, overriding border-radius to 0px.
Hover states for all interactive elements (e.g., -translate-y-[1px] for cards, color changes).
Smooth staggered entrance animations for quote history lists.
Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Apply explicit transitions (e.g., transition-colors).
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
Focus rings MUST be visible (e.g., ring-2 ring-orange-500).
Do not use fully transparent headers over content. Must use bg-white/70 with backdrop-blur.

images.description: Massive offshore drilling rig against a clear blue sky
images.category: Hero/Login Background or Empty State Illustration
Quote Generation empty state or documentation header

icons.rules: Use Duotone or Regular weight. Perfect for dense dashboards and industrial precision.

visual_enhancers: Grid Borders (The Technical Look): Use border-collapse style layout for the P&L calculation grids to expose the skeleton.
Data Highlighting: Use a soft orange tint (bg-orange-50) for the 'Margin' and 'Total Profit' cells to draw attention immediately.

Document Preview: For the 'Customize Quotation Page', implement a 'Neumorphic Tactile' view where the document looks like a physical A4 paper sitting on a slightly darker gray workspace with a soft ambient shadow.
instructions_to_main_agent: Create a robust multipage or multi-tab layout using React and Tailwind.
Implement a 'Dashboard' view showing persistent saved quotes (History) and total margins.

Implement a 'Quote Builder' view with sections for Client Details (editable placeholders), Line Items (Sales, Rental, Services with UoM toggle, daily/lump-sum toggle), and Settings (Tax, Payment Terms, Lead Time, Currency).
Include real-time Margin and P&L calculation logic at the bottom of the quote builder.
For the PDF Export, provide a 'Preview' modal or section that visually represents an A4 page, allowing the user to customize placeholders (client name, company) before printing.
Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx), use plain JavaScript (.js) for components.
Use Phosphor Icons for technical, sharp iconography.
Apply 'data-testid' to ALL buttons, inputs, toggles, and critical data display elements.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid generic 'AI slop' UI. Do not center-align the main app layout. Maintain left-alignment for all dense data and forms.
Create depth through subtle structural layers (e.g., page background vs card background) rather than heavy drop shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully on sticky headers only. No fully transparent overlay backgrounds.
Never apply 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions.
Ensure the UI looks extremely professional, catering to the Oil & Gas sector—sharp, clean, high-contrast, data-dense.
